# aVenture documentation

> aVenture provides private company data through a REST API, CLI, and MCP server.

## Get started

- [API quickstart](https://docs.aventure.vc/quickstart): Make anonymous API requests, then authenticate with a personal API key.
- [CLI quickstart](https://docs.aventure.vc/cli): Install `@aventurevc/aventure-cli`, run a public read, sign in through the browser, and verify with `aventure auth doctor`.
- [MCP quickstart](https://docs.aventure.vc/mcp): Connect an AI client to the hosted MCP server over OAuth, or self-host `@aventurevc/mcp-server`.
- [Answer a real question](https://docs.aventure.vc/first-answer): Chain three public reads — filter the entity list, resolve one record by slug, read its funding rounds — in API, CLI, and MCP form.
- [Authentication](https://docs.aventure.vc/authentication): Choose the credential accepted by an operation.
- [Pagination and filtering](https://docs.aventure.vc/pagination-and-filtering): Page through results and combine filters.
- [Errors](https://docs.aventure.vc/errors): Interpret problem detail responses and rate limits.
- [API reference](https://docs.aventure.vc/api-reference): Read generated endpoint, parameter, and schema documentation.
- [Generated API operation index](https://docs.aventure.vc/api-reference/llms.txt): Discover Fern's generated API operation pages.

## MCP

- [aVenture data MCP](https://mcp.aventure.vc/mcp): Connect with an MCP client over Streamable HTTP. The endpoint uses OAuth protected-resource discovery; an ordinary GET request is not supported.
- [Documentation-search MCP](https://docs.aventure.vc/_mcp/server): Optionally search this documentation through Fern's MCP server. It is separate from the aVenture data MCP.

## Packages and source

- [aVenture CLI source](https://github.com/aventurevc/aventure-cli) and [`@aventurevc/aventure-cli`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@aventurevc/aventure-cli) on npm.
- [aVenture MCP source](https://github.com/aventurevc/aventure-mcp) and [`@aventurevc/mcp-server`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@aventurevc/mcp-server) on npm.
- [`@aventurevc/api-schemas`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@aventurevc/api-schemas) provides TypeScript schemas and types.
